title: Introduce invocation cost-phasing tags and priority-reranker for trace surfaces
author: Sofia Nguyen
description: Background: Investigations into high-cost invocations frequently require operators to stitch together multiple spans that contribute to token billing. This PR introduces deterministic "cost_phase" span tags written at token emission boundaries and a configurable priority-reranker in the ingestion path so high-impact spans are surfaced in compact traces and dashboards. What: 1) Runtime emits telemetry.cost_phase = prebill|billable|postbill for kernel, batching, kv, io spans when a token emission boundary or billing checkpoint occurs. 2) A priority-reranker computes a lightweight cost impact score (tokens_emitted * token_weight + kernel_ms * kernel_weight + kv_miss * kv_weight + wait_ms * wait_weight) and reorders the compact trace digest and the UI summary. 3) New observability assets: Cost Phasing overview dashboard (heatmap: prebill -> billable delta, per-route slope panel) and an alert rule "Per-route billable-slope" that uses the slope of billable tokens with a configurable window and backoff to reduce alert churn. Engineering notes: implementation in src/serving/telemetry/cost_phasing.go and telemetry/ingest/priority_ranker.go; feature gated by TELEMETRY_PRIORITY_RERANK (off by default). Tests include unit coverage for tag emission and score calc, an integration replaybench validating top-3 span recall in compact traces, and a canary against beta tenants. Rollout: gated default-off; staged to internal, then opt-in beta tenants; documented migration behavior (missing tags fall back to default ordering). Related work: ENG-2833 PM-1101; incident SUP-4502 raised need for better span surfacing.
commits: feat: emit cost_phase tags at token/billing boundaries
feat: add priority_reranker streaming transform and feature flag
infra: dashboard and alert definitions for cost phasing overview
test: unit + integration tests and replaybench scenarios
docs: observability runbook and rollout guidance
review_comments: Emily Zhang: Can we keep the number of tagged spans bounded to avoid explosion for high-fanout traces? (author reply: runtime now only tags spans that either cross a token emission or have tokens_emitted>0; micro-spans under threshold are ignored)
Rajiv Menon: Please add a runtime config to tune score weights per-tenant. (author reply: added per-tenant score_override via telemetry config; default weights documented)

Luis Ortega: The alert cooldown needs to honor existing oncall dedupe windows. (author reply: alert rule includes configurable cooldown and ties into existing dedupe policy; test added to replaybench)
merge_outcome: Merged using squash-merge after approvals and green CI. Changelog updated under observability for the next release.
release_notes: Added: cost_phase span tags (prebill, billable, postbill) and a priority-reranker to surface cost-impact spans; Dashboard: Cost Phasing overview with heatmap and per-route slope; Alert: Per-route billable-slope with configurable window and cooldown. Opt-in via TELEMETRY_PRIORITY_RERANK feature flag.
